name: CiteRoute
summary: Generative engine optimisation tool that scores how ready a site is to be cited by AI answer engines, generates agent.json and llms.txt files, and logs AI crawler visits on verified sites; free plan plus paid tracking plans.
best_for: founders and marketers who want to see whether AI crawlers visit their site and how ready their pages look for AI answers, and agencies that want white-label GEO reports for a handful of client sites
skip_if: you want proof of citations rather than a readiness score, you need more than one tracked site without paying agency prices, or you want a vendor with a long track record
honest_knock: The GEO score is CiteRoute's own algorithm, and its terms say outright that it cannot guarantee citations or rankings. The revenue calculator on the home page runs on assumed rates that its footnote calls illustrative. It is a young product with a small public footprint: the home page counts 967+ domains evaluated and 2,043+ scans, and still lists Claude 3.5 among the engines it covers. Real AI-traffic data starts at $79 a month and covers one site. The company operates from Kigali under Rwandan law. We have not used CiteRoute ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per month, billed monthly in advance through Lemon Squeezy as merchant of record
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-13 in a live browser on citeroute.com/pricing, the home page and the terms of service dated 10 September 2026) Four plans, billed monthly. Free costs nothing and includes 10 GEO scans a month, one monitored buyer prompt in GEO Radar, a two-domain competitor comparison, 3 watchlist domains, the agent.json studio, a basic score report and community support. Pro is $79 a month with a 14-day trial: unlimited scans, 10 monitored prompts, a five-way competitor benchmark, one verified site with the tracking tag and a dashboard of real AI bot and crawler visits, 20 watchlist domains, an API key for 500 requests a day, history charts and priority support. Agency is $249 a month with a 14-day trial: 50 monitored prompts, 10 verified client sites, unlimited watchlist, white-label PDF reports, an embeddable badge and 10,000 API requests a day. Enterprise is custom. API calls beyond the daily plan limit are charged per call: $0.02 for a GEO score, $0.01 for a verification and $0.05 for AI-traffic data. The terms say Lemon Squeezy is the merchant of record and handles VAT and sales tax, subscriptions renew monthly until cancelled, you keep access to the end of the paid month after cancelling, and a full refund can be requested within 14 days of the initial purchase. CiteRoute operates from Kigali, Rwanda, under Rwandan law.

compare_with.name: Omniseo
compare_with.why: Omniseo is in our dossiers too, re-verified on 28 September 2026: Essentials $89 a month for 4 AI channels, 50 prompts and 5 seats, Professional $349, with a 7-day free trial and a half-price first month. CiteRoute, read on 13 October 2026, is $79 a month on Pro for 10 monitored prompts, one verified site with AI-crawler analytics and unlimited scans, with a free plan and a 14-day trial. Omniseo watches many more prompts per dollar; CiteRoute adds crawler logs from your own site and a free tier to start on.
